CustomField.description: Hidden field that populates based on Product Name (NB). Product Name Initial pulls from this field and is needed to correctly format commas separating values.
CustomField.formula:
IF( OR( Contains(Product_Name_NB__c, "Tier Five - Annual"), Contains(Product_Name_NB__c, "Tier Five - Monthly"), Contains(Product_Name_NB__c, "Tier One - Monthly"), Contains(Product_Name_NB__c, "Tier One - Annual"), Contains(Product_Name_NB__c, "Tier Two, Three, Four - Annual"), Contains(Product_Name_NB__c, "Tier Two, Three, Four - Monthly"), Contains(Product_Name_NB__c, "Oyster Scale")),
"EOR, ", Null)
&
IF( OR( Contains(Product_Name_NB__c, "Contractor"), Contains(Product_Name_NB__c, "Oyster Shell")),
"Contractor, ", Null)
&
IF( OR( Contains(Product_Name_NB__c, "Benefits Enrollment"), Contains(Product_Name_NB__c, "Equity")),
"Benefits, ", Null)
&
IF( OR( Contains(Product_Name_NB__c, "Global Payroll")),
"Global Payroll, ", Null)
&
IF( OR( Contains(Product_Name_NB__c, "Salary Insights")),
"Salary Insights, ", Null)
CustomField.label: Product Name Initial (Hidden)
